identity.name: NexusERP
identity.tone: Command Center, Executive, Precision, Luxury Utility
identity.core_philosophy: The Batman of ERPs. Dark, precise, gold-accented, and incredibly fast.
identity.audience: Business Owners, CFOs, HR Directors who value clarity and prestige.

heading.usage: All headings (h1-h6). Use strictly for titles and major metrics.

body.usage: All body text, navigation, data tables, inputs.

general_rules: No rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px) maximum for a sharp, professional look.
Cards must not have heavy shadows. Use 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/5) to define edges.
Inputs and Selects must have a dark background (#0F1420) and light border (#2D3748).
Buttons: Primary buttons are GOLD (#C9A84C) with BLACK text. Secondary buttons are Outline (Border Gold) or Ghost.
Data Visualizations: Use Recharts. Stroke width 2px. Axis lines strictly #2D3748.
Tables: Header background #0F1420. Row hover #161C2D. Border color #1F2937.

layout_strategies.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#0F1420] border-r border-white/5 h-screen sticky top-0 flex flex-col
layout_strategies.mobile_nav: h-16 bg-[#0F1420] border-t border-white/5 fixed bottom-0 w-full flex justify-around items-center z-50 md:hidden

motion.micro_interactions: Active states on sidebar items should have a subtle gold glow (bg-gold/10 text-gold).

assets.logo_strategy: Text-based logo 'NexusERP' using the Heading Font (Georgia). Gold icon (Abstract Hexagon or N) if needed.
assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Stroke width 1.5px for elegance. 2px for active states.

specific_page_instructions.login: Split screen. Left: 40% Width with Image + Gold overlay. Right: Form. Background #07090F.
specific_page_instructions.super_admin_dashboard: Header: 'Platform Overview'. Metrics: MRR (Gold), Active Businesses (Sapphire), Churn (Crimson). Table: 'Recent Signups'.
specific_page_instructions.business_dashboard: Header: 'Company Performance'. Metrics: Revenue (Gold), Expenses (Crimson), Net Profit (Emerald). Chart: Revenue vs Expenses (Area Chart).
specific_page_instructions.hr_dashboard: Header: 'People & Culture'. Metrics: Headcount (Sapphire), On Leave (Amber). Grid: Employee Directory + Leave Requests.
specific_page_instructions.finance_dashboard: Header: 'Financial Health'. Metrics: Outstanding Invoices (Amber), Monthly Burn (Crimson). Table: Recent Invoices.
specific_page_instructions.staff_portal: Mobile-first focus. Big buttons for 'Clock In' (Emerald) / 'Clock Out' (Crimson). 'My Payslips' list.

universal_guidelines: NEVER use black text on the dark background. Always use white or light grey (#E5E7EB).
NO gradients on backgrounds. Use solid colors. Texture (noise) is allowed but keep it subtle.
All monetary values must display 2 decimal places (e.g., $1,250.00).
Use Skeleton loaders (bg-[#161C2D] animate-pulse) instead of spinners.
Borders are your friend for separation. 1px border-white/5 is better than a shadow in dark mode.
Gap strategy: Use gap-6 or gap-8 to let data breathe.
Don't ask questions. Build based on these specs.
